certified: Bidder eligibility: technical committee signs against the stated criteria, before price opening (Works Manual 2025 model).

mustHave: Bid period 21 days minimum; written replies at least 5 days before opening.
Bid security 2 to 5% of estimate, valid 45 days past bid validity.
Experience: 3 works at 40%, 2 at 50% or 1 at 80% of estimate.
Average turnover of last three years at least 30% of estimate.
Bids stay valid 90 days unless stated; issue the award inside that window.

certified: Running bill: site engineer measures, senior engineer checks, approver passes under delegation; FIDIC 14.6 certificate model.
Variation: approving authority signs in writing before work starts; rate agreed from analysis (Works Manual 7.3.2).

sent: Purchase or work order to vendor, with terms and schedules

Committed and paid values to Finance and Planning

mustHave: Pay micro and small suppliers within 45 days (15 without a written agreement).
Contractor TDS 1% or 2% above ₹30,000 a bill or ₹1 lakh a year.
Retention about 5% of each bill: half at taking over, half after defects period.
Mobilisation advance at most 10% against bank guarantee; materials advance at most 75%.
Price variation normally only for contracts over 18 months; variations need prior written approval.

mustHave: Cement: 10 bags high at most, 150-200 mm off floor, 600 mm from walls.
Concrete (IS 456): 4 samples by 50 m3, then 1 per extra 50 m3.
Rebar: certificate with heat number; batch mass tolerance 7%, 5%, 3% by size band.
Cement and rebar must carry the BIS Standard Mark; check the licence number.
Written objection within 15 days of delivery, else deemed accepted (micro and small suppliers).
